notes.title: Vegawon’s Legacy Devlog #2 – November 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Vegawon’s Legacy fans,[/h1]
In November, we had an intense and productive working period for Vegawon's Legacy. We both strengthened our technical infrastructure and introduced many innovations that will enrich the player experience. Here are the important developments of this month:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205203/f9408de340c2274b8bb6b54d01835b1d63de87f0.png[/img]


[h2][b]Land of the Crescent: Games from Turkey Steam Festival
[/b][/h2]
We updated our Steam page for the Games from Turkey Steam Festival. While making the page description more engaging and professional, we added new cover images and screenshots to attract potential players. In the images, we included scenes that highlight the aesthetic world and gameplay mechanics of the game. We also focused on SEO-oriented edits in the text to give the game a better place in the Steam algorithm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205203/3ed81a1e2202f23a8551f29f93f3a5caeaa722bc.jpg[/img]

[h2]More Modular and Scalable AI System
[/h2]
To streamline future development, we implemented a new modular AI system. This system allows all basic enemies and bosses to be derived from a single base class, making it easier to expand and refine behaviors. With this new structure, we can create more complex and dynamic enemy interactions while significantly speeding up the development process. The updated AI system also lays the foundation for more innovative and adaptive boss battles, ensuring they remain engaging and unpredictable for players.


[h2]DWS Sound Manager Updates[/h2]
Our custom-built DWS Sound Manager received substantial updates and bug fixes this month. We resolved issues such as audio overlaps and settings not saving properly. Additionally, we revamped the user interface to be more intuitive and user-friendly, streamlining workflows for sound designers and developers alike. These updates ensure a smoother and more efficient audio design process, enhancing both creativity and functionality.



[h2]New Injured System
[/h2]
We introduced a new Injured System to enhance the gameplay’s tactical depth and emotional intensity. Now, when the player's health falls below 20%, their character will enter an injured state. This state includes:

A 30% reduction in movement speed, emphasizing the character's weakened condition.

Unique idle and movement animations that visually depict the injury.

This system encourages players to reconsider their survival strategies and adds a layer of tension to critical moments. The animations are meticulously designed to reflect the character's vulnerability and create a more immersive experience.


[h2]New Landing System
[/h2]
We’ve added a new landing animation to enhance the feeling of impact when falling from a certain height. Now, when the player drops from a significant height, a short "recovery" animation will play. This animation provides a moment of visual recovery, reinforcing the feeling of realism and adding an extra layer of immersion to the player’s movement dynamics



[h2]First Boss: The Dark Knight
[/h2]
We’re excited to unveil the first boss of the game, The Dark Knight, a formidable adversary designed to leave a lasting impression:

The battle unfolds across three distinct phases, each introducing new attack patterns and strategies.

The boss utilizes unique behavior trees in each phase, requiring players to adapt and think strategically.

This challenging and dynamic encounter sets a high bar for future boss fights, combining intense combat mechanics with engaging design to deliver a thrilling experience.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/a84d3c_cd3eb52df35b457193b8498afe9dda17~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/a84d3c_cd3eb52df35b457193b8498afe9dda17~mv2.png[/img]

[h2]New Environment Designs and Artistic Enhancements[/h2]

Our art team has been working hard to further deepen the mystical world of Mount Petra. New backgrounds, ground designs, and environmental elements (props) have been added to the Crypt of Petra, Foothills of Petra, and Mt. Petra Mine regions. These areas have been redesigned with different aesthetic languages ​​to create a dark and enchanting atmosphere. Each area has been enhanced with detailed visuals and impressive compositions. The new environmental elements provide a visual experience that further engages players in the sense of discovery and adds to the atmosphere of the story.


[h2]Input System Improvements
[/h2]
To enhance gameplay fluidity, we made significant improvements to the input system:

Input buffering was implemented, allowing for better responsiveness during fast-paced actions like attacks and jumps. This ensures that player inputs are recognized more consistently, even in high-action moments.

Every attack can now be canceled regardless of the situation

Additional fine-tuning was applied to movement and attack controls, offering greater precision and a more seamless feel.

These updates provide a smoother and more responsive control experience, ensuring that gameplay remains both engaging and intuitive.




[h2]Physics System and Technical Optimizations
[/h2]
We conducted an extensive review and optimization of the physics system, addressing inconsistencies in physical interactions and refining overall performance. These efforts resulted in:

A more fluid gameplay experience, with reduced hitches and glitches.

no more sliding enemies or items on the ground

Improved realism in physical interactions, ensuring that movements and environmental reactions feel natural.




Thank you for your continued support as we build a better Vegawon's Legacy! Stay tuned for more updates and new features in the coming months.


The DWS Interactive Team

notes.title: Vegawon’s Legacy Devlog #1
notes.content:
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/a84d3c_130791f6a9df45fcb74ec9aac96f737b~mv2.png[/img]


[h2]Dear Vegawon’s Legacy fans,
[/h2]

The team at DWS Interactive is thrilled to share the progress we’ve made this month! October was incredibly productive, and we’ve added numerous new features to our game. Here’s a rundown of what we worked on…


[h2]Our Custom Audio System! DWS Sound Engine[/h2]


One of the biggest highlights this month was developing our very own audio management system. You might be wondering, “Why did we need this?” Well, we realized just how essential music and sound effects are in shaping the experience, so we aimed to make it the best it could be! With this system, we can:


- Play dynamic ambient sounds that adapt to different environments

- Group and professionally edit all sound effects directly in Unity

- Manage unique ambient sounds for each region

- Control character movement sounds in greater detail

- Support external APIs

- …and so much more that we can’t fully describe yet!


This system is not just for Vegawon’s Legacy – it’s designed as a top-tier professional audio tool that we plan to share on the Unity Asset Store, so other developers can benefit from it too!


[h2]New Ability: Force Push![/h2]


We’ve finally added the long-awaited Force Push ability to the game! With this new skill, you’ll be able to:


- Knock enemies back

- Interact with objects in the environment

- Use it to solve puzzles

- Add a new dimension to your combos



[h2]Swimming Mechanic[/h2]


Our character can now swim! This new mechanic opens up exciting possibilities:


- Explore underwater areas

- Discover hidden locations

- Encounter new types of enemies

- Collect underwater treasures


[h2]New Animations and Improvements[/h2]


- We added an interaction animation for all interactive objects – now you’ll see the character bend down to pick up a weapon from the ground.

- Potions now have a drinking animation, so you’ll see your character pull out and drink a health potion.

- If your character runs at top speed and stops suddenly, a “Run to Stop” animation will play.


[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]


We’re constantly working on the visual side of the game:


- Completed our new cover design

- Enhanced the realism of grass and wind effects

- Added a new loading screen (you’ll be able to read gameplay tips while you wait!)

- Introduced new region discovery notifications


[h2]Weapon Variety[/h2]


We’ve added new variations for the axe and dagger. Each weapon now has:


- Unique attack animations

- Special abilities

- Visual effects

- Sound effects


[h2]Smarter NPCs![/h2]


We’ve taken the first steps to make our NPCs smarter. Soon, you’ll encounter:


- More intelligent enemies

- More interactive friendly NPCs

- Dynamic dialogue options


[h2]Technical Improvements[/h2]


We’ve made numerous improvements behind the scenes as well:


- Smoother gameplay performance

- Shorter loading times

- Bug fixes and increased stability

- Improved overall performance


[h1]Thank You![/h1]


In the words of an old saying from the continent of Vegawon, “A game is only as beautiful as the people who play it.” Thanks to your support and feedback, Vegawon’s Legacy grows more beautiful every day. Thank you for following our journey and joining us on this adventure! 🌟


“May the adventure never end!” Until next month…

  

The DWS Interactive Team
